data.name: The Flinch: Unforgiven West
data.detailed_description:
ONE HAND, ONE GUN, AND TEN DEADLY SINS

A deal was struck in the darkness of a prison cell. The price of freedom is simple: Erase 10 names from the Warden's "Black Ledger." But in this world, nothing is simple.

The Flinch: Unforgiven West invites you to an unforgiving, stylized "Noir-Western" world where you fight not just against enemies, but against your own nerves using nothing but your mouse.

KEY FEATURES

🔫 Physics-Based Aiming (Mouse-Only Controls) Forget the keyboard. The entire game is played with just one hand, giving you total control over the trigger. There is no auto-lock. Adrenaline, the weight of the gun, and the sway of your hand make every shot a gamble. Hold your breath, wait for the perfect moment, and click to kill. In this game, there is no "Health Bar," only a "Margin of Error."

🎨 Sharp-Edged Noir Aesthetics In a pitch-black world, the only thing lighting your path is the muzzle flash. A 2.5D visual feast blending sharp silhouettes inspired by classic graphic novels with a black-and-white and blood-red atmosphere. You will recognize enemies not just by their shapes, but by the ominous glint in their eyes.

🗺️ A Living, Unforgiving Map Navigate through 3D canyons, dark mines, and ominous towns on an open-world map with strategic depth—all controlled by your cursor. Use shadows to avoid ambushes, manage your scarce resources, and hunt down the killer whose silhouette now haunts your "Wanted" poster.

⚖️ Choose Your Soul: Blood or Redemption? The "Honor System" changes not just the story, but the very way you handle your mouse.

  • The Red Path: Be ruthless. Your gun kicks harder but deals lethal damage.

  • The Blue Path: Be merciful. Disarm enemies with precision shots. Requires nerves of steel. The world and its colors—your poncho and your eyes—will shift to reflect your state of mind.

💀 A Cursed Economy Here, wealth isn't the dollars in your pocket; it's the bullet in your chamber. Every shot costs a meal. A blind fire can lead to bankruptcy. When you die, you lose not just your money, but your dignity. To get it back, you must face your own ghost.

data.short_description: To pull the trigger takes guts; to miss invites death. Hunt down 10 sinners in this mouse-only Noir Western. Battle your own nerves and a cursed revolver where hand tremors make every duel a gamble. How steady is your aim?
